# Advisory Locking Mechanism

This feature implements an advisory locking mechanism, which allows per-repository serialization of operations to prevent concurrent access issues. It uses a unique key for each repository slug, enabling safe access to the database during critical operations.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/storage/db.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.db.repo_lock_key`
- `knowledge_compiler/storage/db.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.db.advisory_lock`
